cases.setup: Small valid sealed preview ZIP with nested UTF-8 names and a harmless VERIFY.py execution tripwire; new output under spaces/Unicode.
cases.expect: Complete admission; owned child readiness before GET; exact homepage/assets; actual child exit; full source/archive/extracted conservation; tripwire absent.

cases.setup: Valid ZIP bytes with deliberately wrong caller-supplied SHA256.
cases.expect: Refusal before output directory or server creation; no HTTP; original unchanged.

cases.setup: ZIP whose caller SHA matches but one harmless payload differs from its retained manifest identity.
cases.expect: Refusal before output directory/server; no ZIP verifier execution; original unchanged.

cases.setup: Otherwise valid ZIP carrying duplicate or unsafe relative member identity, with matching outer digest.
cases.expect: Explicit admission refusal before filesystem extraction; no output or server; no path outside owned root touched.

cases.setup: Independently owned loopback sentinel listener on selected port; valid source ZIP.
cases.expect: Receiver refuses without issuing any GET to sentinel; sentinel request count remains zero and listener remains owned/alive; only receiver child reaped; created receipt truthful.

cases.setup: Valid source ZIP and pre-existing output directory containing a sentinel file.
cases.expect: Refusal without replacing/deleting sentinel or starting server; exact original archive and destination witness preserved.

limits: No broad security fuzzing, payload execution, browser, build or product replay. CLI and final schema binding pending root.
